title: The Bastion Standoff
logline: Two rival scrapper syndicates trade fire over a drifting orbital defense platform whose automated gun pods remain hot because station management concealed the shutdown codes.

roles.description: Torn between feuding scrapper crews while local scrap metal prices plummet under unharvested platform debris.
Controls an outlaw salvage outfit that uses militarized cutters to claim derelict platforms.
An unyielding port authority officer who insists that all orbital wreckage belongs to the station commonwealth.
A gutted orbital bastion floating dead in an unlit debris ring with active weapon capacitors.
Automated defense pods still slaved to the platform's corrupted targeting beacon.
An armored salvage cutter retrofitted with heavy plasma cutters and rail mounts.
A confederation of independent breakers claiming customary salvage rights over decommissioned hulls.

public_situation: A decommissioned orbital defense platform is drifting into commercial transit lanes, but salvage crews cannot approach its automated guns.
private_truth: The station manager deliberately withheld the platform's shutdown frequency to let rival salvage outfits destroy each other over the scrap rights.

beats.public_change: Navigation beacons issue a navigation exclusion zone around the drifting defense bastion after a scrapper tug is vaporized.

missions.reason: He needs an outside reconnaissance scan of the platform's capacitor relays to locate the master telemetry beacon before outlaw scrappers breach it.
missions.private_fact: He already suspects station administration is stalling the disarmament to force salvage crews into dangerous breach attempts.

beats.public_change: Outlaw scrapper cutters surround the perimeter, trading fire with automated gun pods while attempting to latch cutting lines.

missions.reason: He needs an experienced mercenary pilot to destroy the active gun pods so station salvage teams can board the central umbilical.
missions.private_fact: He plans to award the platform's salvage rights exclusively to an offshore trust that quietly holds his gambling debts.

beats.public_change: Outlaw scrappers board the gantry and attempt to pry open the armor magazine, triggering an emergency security scramble.

missions.reason: He needs the platform's cryptographic transponder recovered from scrapper looters before they broadcast false salvage title claims.
missions.private_fact: The transponder records show the station manager received the shutdown codes three weeks before the first scrapper died.

player_choice.prompt: The recovered transponder proves {role:station_manager} let salvagers die for scrap profit, but {role:scrapper_boss} offers a massive bounty to bury the data.

options.label: Hand the transponder to the marshal to arrest the station manager
Sell the transponder to the scrapper boss to secure monopoly rights
Force the manager and scrapper boss into an equal scrap partnership

beats.public_change: Port authority cutters deploy to seize the scrapper fleet, sparking a pitched skirmish outside the defense platform trench.

missions.reason: He needs the heavily armed scrapper cutter neutralized before its plasma cannons breach the platform's core reactor.
missions.private_fact: The scrapper captain hails mid-fight, offering a cut of the platform's armor plating if the pilot disables the marshal's patrol sensor buoys instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the cryptographic transponder to the marshal, proving the manager withheld safety codes.
resolutions.summary: {role:station_manager} is arrested for reckless endangerment. The platform is decommissioned under naval oversight, while {role:salvage_marshal} takes control of port salvage.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot uncovered records showing a station manager let scrappers die to clear an orbital platform.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the scrapper cutter and backs port authority enforcement.
resolutions.summary: Port authority forces secure {role:defense_platform}. {role:scrapper_syndicate} is driven from the sector, and platform scrap is auctioned into the station treasury.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the scrapper flagship captain's offer, helping the syndicate seize the platform.
resolutions.summary: {role:scrapper_syndicate} strips {role:defense_platform} down to the frame. The marshal is recalled in disgrace, while cheap armor plate floods local black markets.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces a split between station management and the scrapper syndicate.
resolutions.summary: A shared salvage compact is signed. Scrappers dismantle the platform under station tax stamps, ending the standoff without prosecution.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never engages or scans fail.
resolutions.summary: Uncontrolled platform fire damages commercial freighters, forcing harbor authorities to seal the orbital corridor and declare the sector an unnavigable hazard zone.

loose_threads.detail: The emergency battery override manifest includes a forged authorization stamp identical to customs clearance seals.
A foreclosure notice against the scrapper syndicate's repair dock was purchased by a port administration shell company.

radio_hooks: Commercial transit corridor rerouted as decommissioned platform weapons remain hot.
Scrapper crews exchange threats with port marshals over derelict salvage permits.
{role:station_manager} calls for patience regarding orbital battery disarming efforts.

voice_direction.station_manager: Hedging, evasive, and polite. Always redirects technical questions toward legal jurisdictional boundaries.
voice_direction.scrapper_boss: Gravelly, direct, and aggressive. Speaks in short declarations and sneers whenever station regulations are cited.
voice_direction.salvage_marshal: Rigid, clipped, and procedural. Cites administrative subsection numbers verbatim when issuing navigational orders.
